portal_description:
The gnome-keyring session daemon manages passwords and other types of secrets
for the user, storing them encrypted with a main password. Applications can use
the gnome-keyring library to integrate with the key ring.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the gnome-keyring packages were compiled without the RELRO
(Relocation Read-Only) and PIE (Position Independent Executable) hardening
flags. Programs provided by gnome-keyring could be vulnerable to various attacks
based on overwriting the ELF section of these programs. The gnome-keyring
binaries are now built with PIE and RELRO support. As a result, the
gnome-keyring binary is better secured against various memory corruption attacks
and also against attacks based on overwriting the ELF section of the programs
that gnome-keyring provides. (BZ#1092550)

Users of gnome-keyring are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
fix this bug.
